title: Supported centered ordinary and formal blowup towers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal, and $r\geq0$. An ordinary supported centered blowup tower is an ordinary finite blowup tower with its ordered centers in the sense of [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule], with exactly $r$ centers: it consists of schemes $X_0,\ldots,X_r$ over $X$, a specified $X_0\cong X$, arrows $X_{i+1}\to X_i$, and ordered coherent ideals $J_i$ on $X_i$ [pqf-def-coherent] with $(I\mathcal O_{X_i})^{N_i}\subseteq J_i$ for some $N_i\geq1$, together with isomorphisms of those arrows with the actual blowups [def-nagata-global-blowup]. A formal supported centered tower has the same indices over $\widehat X_I$, with Noetherian adic formal levels and coherent open ideals, and each arrow is the formal blowup of its specified ideal [def-per-noetherian-adic-formal-system]. An isomorphism of either type of towers is a family of level isomorphisms over the fixed base, commuting with all arrows and preserving every ordered ideal. A completion comparison identifies every specified formal level with the completion of its ordinary level and every formal ideal with the extended ordinary ideal, with the structural-map equations over each ordinary level and over $X$. At every sufficiently large finite order its center agreement asserts a unique isomorphism of center schemes over the ordinary level, hence equivalence of nonemptiness and regularity [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Singular support of the centers means their images in $X$ are nonregular points; on a formal center use its map through a closed infinitesimal thickening of $X$. Nowhere density means that each ordinary center has nowhere dense support in its own level. All identity blowup stages and their ideals remain in order; empty schemes and $r=0$ are included.
